scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/shared && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm run start:dev --workspace @whatsapp-business/api" "npm run start:dev --workspace @whatsapp-business/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @whatsapp-business/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/shared && npm run test:e2e --workspace @whatsapp-business/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/shared && npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/api && npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/worker && npm run build --workspace @whatsapp-business/web
scripts.verify: npm run prisma:generate && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
